"""Independent raw first8 CPU readout audit; execute only after worker release.

Reuse only immutable stdlib referee helpers, never inference/benchmark code.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import math
import runpy
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

type Json = None | bool | int | float | str | list[Json] | dict[str, Json]
type Object = dict[str, Json]
ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
RESULTS = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results"
REFEREE = Path("/private/tmp/wyat-cpu-prefix-production-audit.py")
REFEREE_SHA = "2353659ee2a2a1960581d90fa9bc1e33574a5d520a166e74f3cb838303f28a0b"
SOURCE_GATE_SHA = "619669b8188815ab501df6f57c1f6ecfb5f3420a20bc708a49f43cd30fea7026"
CORE_SHA = "53a776840ce6d406a710b5beca586a38d4ae17e1a2e55e3f0c35e605fd7e1c2e"
SCHEDULE = (
    ("warmup", "original"),
    ("warmup", "retained"),
    ("warmup", "selected"),
    ("ordinary", "original"),
    ("ordinary", "retained"),
    ("ordinary", "selected"),
    ("ordinary", "selected"),
    ("ordinary", "retained"),
    ("ordinary", "original"),
    ("profile", "retained"),
    ("profile", "selected"),
)


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


class Arguments(argparse.Namespace):
    main: Path
    output: Path
    main_sha: str
    journal_sha: str
    wall_sha: str
    archive_sha: str
    log_sha: str


def audit(args: Arguments) -> Object:
    require(digest(REFEREE) == REFEREE_SHA, "Pure referee bytes changed")
    helpers = runpy.run_path(str(REFEREE))
    obj = cast(Callable[[Json], Object], helpers["obj"])
    array = cast(Callable[[Json], list[Json]], helpers["array"])
    text = cast(Callable[[Json], str], helpers["text"])
    pinned = cast(Callable[[Path, str], Object], helpers["pinned"])
    scores = cast(Callable[[Json], list[float]], helpers["logits"])
    decide = cast(
        Callable[[list[float], list[str]], tuple[list[float], list[str]]],
        helpers["decision"],
    )
    compare = cast(
        Callable[[list[float], list[float], list[str]], Object], helpers["compare"]
    )
    passed = cast(Callable[[Object], bool], helpers["gate_passed"])
    canonical = cast(Callable[[list[Json]], str], helpers["canonical_digest"])
    native_sources = cast(Callable[[], dict[str, str]], helpers["validate_baseline"])()
    model_files = cast(dict[str, str], helpers["MODEL_FILES"])
    model_id = cast(str, helpers["MODEL_ID"])
    data_sha, ref_sha = (
        cast(str, helpers["DATA_SHA"]),
        cast(str, helpers["REFERENCE_SHA"]),
    )
    input_sha = cast(str, helpers["INPUT_SHA"])
    main = pinned(args.main, args.main_sha)
    wall_path = args.main.with_suffix(".wall.json")
    wall = pinned(wall_path, args.wall_sha)
    require(
        wall["timeout_seconds"] == 180
        and wall["timed_out"] is False
        and type(wall["exit_code"]) is int
        and wall["exit_code"] in (0, 1)
        and wall["completed"] is (wall["exit_code"] == 0)
        and type(wall["elapsed_seconds"]) in (int, float)
        and 0 <= cast(float, wall["elapsed_seconds"]) <= 180,
        "Owned terminal/cap unsupported",
    )
    command = [text(value) for value in array(wall["command"])]
    entry = "benchmarks.analysis.torch.readout.run"
    require(
        entry in command
        and "--worker" in command
        and "--output" in command
        and command[command.index("--output") + 1] == str(args.main),
        "Wrong owned worker",
    )
    model = Path(command[command.index(entry) + 1])
    log = args.main.with_suffix(".log")
    require(digest(log) == args.log_sha, "Log bytes changed")
    journal = args.main.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl")
    require(digest(journal) == args.journal_sha, "Journal bytes changed")
    raw = [cast(Json, json.loads(line)) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines()]
    source_gate = pinned(RESULTS / "cpu-readout-screen-review.json", SOURCE_GATE_SHA)
    core = pinned(RESULTS / "cpu-readout-core-review.json", CORE_SHA)
    require(
        source_gate["passed"] is True and core["passed"] is True,
        "Independent gates unsupported",
    )
    descriptor = obj(main["source_archive"])
    require(descriptor["sha256"] == args.archive_sha, "Wrong executed archive")
    archive_path = Path(text(descriptor["path"]))
    archive = pinned(archive_path, args.archive_sha)
    archived: dict[str, str] = {}
    archived_text: dict[str, str] = {}
    for row in array(archive["files"]):
        item = obj(row)
        name = text(item["name"])
        path = text(item["path"])
        require(name not in archived, "Duplicate source names")
        checksum = hashlib.sha256(text(item["text"]).encode()).hexdigest()
        require(
            checksum == item["sha256"] and digest(Path(path)) == checksum,
            "Source archive/current mismatch",
        )
        if path in native_sources:
            require(checksum == native_sources[path], "Changed native-verified code")
        archived[name] = checksum
        archived_text[name] = text(item["text"])
    require(archived == obj(main["source_sha256"]), "Executed inventory mismatch")
    for proof in (source_gate, core):
        for name, value in obj(proof["source_sha256"]).items():
            require(archived[name] == value, "Reviewed source differs from execution")
    production = {
        str(Path(path).relative_to(ROOT)): value
        for path, value in native_sources.items()
        if Path(path).is_relative_to(ROOT / "wyat")
    }
    require(
        len(production) == 22
        and all(archived[name] == value for name, value in production.items()),
        "Production source identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        main["accepted"] is False and main["performance_passed"] is False,
        "Exploratory promotion is prohibited",
    )
    policy = obj(main["process_policy"])
    require(
        policy
        == {
            "flash_sdpa": True,
            "math_sdpa": True,
            "efficient_sdpa": True,
            "cudnn_sdpa": True,
            "float32_matmul_precision": "highest",
            "cpu_autocast": False,
        },
        "Process policy differs",
    )
    require(
        all(value is True for value in obj(main["sdpa_flags"]).values())
        and set(obj(main["sdpa_flags"]))
        == {"_is_torch_mps_available", "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13"},
        "Native masked-GQA flags differ",
    )
    runtime = obj(main["runtime"])
    require(
        obj(runtime["packages"])["torch"] == "2.14.1"
        and obj(runtime["packages"])["transformers"] == "5.18.0"
        and runtime["torch_git_version"] == "5c4886908584029761b579af026dcfb627c84070",
        "Runtime differs",
    )
    data = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    ref_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json"
    require(
        digest(data) == data_sha and digest(ref_path) == ref_sha,
        "Reference/input bytes differ",
    )
    all_cases = [cast(Json, json.loads(line)) for line in data.read_text().splitlines()]
    require(
        len(all_cases) == 77 and canonical(all_cases) == input_sha,
        "Full input identity differs",
    )
    cases = [obj(case) for case in all_cases[:8]]
    reference = pinned(ref_path, ref_sha)
    ref_rows = [obj(row) for row in array(reference["rows"])]
    require(
        len(ref_rows) == 77 and reference["model_id"] == model_id,
        "Full frozen reference differs",
    )
    prefix = array(ref_rows[0]["token_ids"])[:25]
    for case, ref in zip(all_cases, ref_rows, strict=True):
        require(
            obj(case)["id"] == ref["id"] and array(ref["token_ids"])[:25] == prefix,
            "Frozen token/case alignment differs",
        )
        tokens = array(ref["token_ids"])
        indices = array(ref["candidate_positions"])
        require(
            all(type(v) is int for v in tokens)
            and 25 < len(tokens) <= 512
            and ref["query_position"] == len(tokens) - 1
            and len(indices) == 6
            and all(type(i) is int and 25 <= i < len(tokens) for i in indices),
            "Frozen token/readout geometry differs",
        )
    refs = ref_rows[:8]
    require(
        main["model_id"] == model_id
        and main["dataset_sha256"] == data_sha
        and main["reference_sha256"] == ref_sha
        and main["full_input_sha256"] == input_sha
        and main["input_sha256"] == canonical(all_cases[:8])
        and main["case_ids"] == [case["id"] for case in cases]
        and main["prefix_tokens"] == prefix
        and main["token_lengths"] == [len(array(row["token_ids"])) for row in ref_rows]
        and main["prefix_state_bytes"] == [5734400, 5734400],
        "Current case/model/prefix identity differs",
    )
    assets = {str(data): data_sha, str(ref_path): ref_sha}
    assets.update({str(model / name): value for name, value in model_files.items()})
    require(
        obj(main["asset_sha256"]) == assets
        and all(digest(Path(name)) == value for name, value in assets.items()),
        "Exact nine model assets/input inventory differs",
    )
    tree = ast.parse(archived_text["benchmarks/analysis/torch/readout/study.py"])
    declared_history = next(
        cast(Object, ast.literal_eval(node.value))
        for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
        and any(
            isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "HISTORY"
            for target in node.targets
        )
    )
    require(
        obj(main["historical_sha256"]) == declared_history
        and obj(main["original_historical_sha256"]) == cast(Object, helpers["HISTORY"]),
        "Historical pin inventory differs",
    )
    for key in ("historical_sha256", "original_historical_sha256"):
        for name, value in obj(main[key]).items():
            require(digest(RESULTS / name) == value, "Historical evidence differs")
    protocol = obj(main["protocol"])
    require(
        protocol["schedule"] == [list(pair) for pair in SCHEDULE]
        and protocol["outcomes"] == 88
        and protocol["batch_size"] == 8
        and protocol["threads"] == 8
        and protocol["dtype"] == "float32"
        and protocol["device"] == "cpu"
        and protocol["max_length"] == 512
        and protocol["token_cache_size"] == 0
        and protocol["prefix_length"] == 25,
        "Frozen schedule/setup differs",
    )
    require(
        obj(main["quality_gate"])
        == {"logit_atol": 1e-3, "logit_rtol": 1e-3, "probability_atol": 1e-4},
        "Original gates changed",
    )
    cycles = [obj(row) for row in array(main["cycles"])]
    require(len(cycles) == len(raw) <= 11, "Returned journal count differs")
    outcomes: list[Json] = []
    predictions: list[list[list[float] | None]] = []
    correct_total = 0
    quality = True
    times: dict[str, list[float]] = {"original": [], "retained": [], "selected": []}
    dispatch_results: dict[str, bool] = {}
    for index, row in enumerate(cycles):
        stage, arm = SCHEDULE[index]
        require(
            row["index"] == index and row["stage"] == stage and row["arm"] == arm,
            "Order differs",
        )
        require(
            {
                key: value
                for key, value in row.items()
                if key not in ("reference_quality", "anchor_quality")
            }
            == obj(raw[index]),
            "Raw journal changed beyond later quality reports",
        )
        cycle = obj(row["cycle"])
        actual_rows = [obj(value) for value in array(cycle["rows"])]
        require(len(actual_rows) == 8, "Eight-case denominator missing")
        unknown: list[str] = []
        row_scores: list[list[float] | None] = []
        correct = 0
        for case, ref, result in zip(cases, refs, actual_rows, strict=True):
            require(
                result["id"] == case["id"] and result["expected"] == case["expected"],
                "Output labels/IDs differ",
            )
            ids = [text(value) for value in array(ref["candidate_ids"])]
            require(
                ids
                == [
                    text(obj(c)["id"])
                    for c in array(obj(case["request"])["candidates"])
                ],
                "Candidate order differs",
            )
            if result["prediction"] is None:
                require(result["correct"] is False, "Unknown result labeled correct")
                unknown.append(text(result["id"]))
                row_scores.append(None)
                quality = False
                outcomes.append(
                    {"index": index, "id": result["id"], "failed_or_missing": True}
                )
                continue
            require(
                result["status"] == "ok" and result["error"] is None,
                "Failed result contains positive prediction",
            )
            decision = obj(result["prediction"])
            logits = scores(decision["scores"])
            probabilities, ranking = decide(logits, ids)
            serialized = scores(decision["probabilities"])
            require(
                len(serialized) == 6
                and all(
                    abs(a - b) <= 2 * max(math.ulp(a), math.ulp(b))
                    for a, b in zip(probabilities, serialized, strict=True)
                ),
                "Softmax replay differs",
            )
            require(
                decision["model_id"] == model_id
                and decision["ranking"] == ranking
                and decision["selected"] == ranking[0],
                "Full rank/selection replay differs",
            )
            is_correct = ranking[0] in array(case["expected"])
            require(result["correct"] is is_correct, "Correctness replay differs")
            correct += is_correct
            gate = compare(scores(ref["legacy_logits"]), logits, ids)
            ref_prob, _ = decide(scores(ref["legacy_logits"]), ids)
            gate["serialized_probabilities_passed"] = all(
                abs(a - b) <= 1e-4 for a, b in zip(ref_prob, serialized, strict=True)
            )
            quality &= passed(gate) and gate["serialized_probabilities_passed"] is True
            row_scores.append(logits)
            outcomes.append(
                {
                    "index": index,
                    "id": result["id"],
                    "expected": case["expected"],
                    "candidate_ids": cast(Json, ids),
                    "scores": cast(Json, logits),
                    "probabilities": cast(Json, serialized),
                    "ranking": cast(Json, ranking),
                    "selected": ranking[0],
                    "correct": is_correct,
                    "reference_gate": gate,
                }
            )
        require(
            row["unknown_case_ids"] == unknown
            and cycle["failed"] == len(unknown)
            and cycle["correct"] == correct,
            "Failure/accuracy bookkeeping differs",
        )
        correct_total += correct
        predictions.append(row_scores)
        require(
            all(
                type(result["latency_ms"]) in (int, float)
                and math.isfinite(cast(float, result["latency_ms"]))
                and cast(float, result["latency_ms"]) >= 0
                for result in actual_rows
            ),
            "Row residence unsupported",
        )
        value = cycle["latency_ms"]
        require(
            type(value) in (int, float)
            and math.isfinite(cast(float, value))
            and cast(float, value) > 0,
            "Canonical cohort clock unsupported",
        )
        if stage == "ordinary":
            value = cycle["latency_ms"]
            require(
                type(value) in (int, float)
                and math.isfinite(cast(float, value))
                and cast(float, value) > 0,
                "Ordinary clock evidence unsupported",
            )
            times[arm].append(float(cast(float, value)))
        if stage == "profile":
            events = [obj(e) for e in array(row["operator_self_times"])]
            require(
                all(type(e["count"]) is int and e["count"] >= 0 for e in events),
                "Invalid operator count",
            )
            flash = [
                e
                for e in events
                if e["operator"] == "aten::_scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_for_cpu"
            ]
            fallback = any(
                e["operator"]
                in (
                    "aten::_scaled_dot_product_attention_math",
                    "aten::repeat_interleave",
                )
                and cast(int, e["count"]) > 0
                for e in events
            )
            full = [
                [8, 16, 167, 128],
                [8, 8, 192, 128],
                [8, 8, 192, 128],
                [],
                [],
                [8, 1, 167, 192],
                [],
            ]
            short = [
                [8, 16, 7, 128],
                [8, 8, 192, 128],
                [8, 8, 192, 128],
                [],
                [],
                [8, 1, 7, 192],
                [],
            ]
            expected = [(full, 27), (short, 1)] if arm == "selected" else [(full, 28)]
            dispatch_results[arm] = (
                not fallback
                and len(flash) == len(expected)
                and all(
                    sum(
                        cast(int, e["count"])
                        for e in flash
                        if e["input_shapes"] == shape
                    )
                    == count
                    for shape, count in expected
                )
            )
    paired: list[Json] = []
    for left in range(len(predictions)):
        for right in range(left + 1, len(predictions)):
            for ref, a, b in zip(
                refs, predictions[left], predictions[right], strict=True
            ):
                if a is None or b is None:
                    quality = False
                    continue
                gate = compare(a, b, [text(v) for v in array(ref["candidate_ids"])])
                quality &= passed(gate)
                paired.append(
                    {
                        "left_index": left,
                        "right_index": right,
                        "id": ref["id"],
                        "gate": gate,
                    }
                )
    complete = len(cycles) == 11
    require(
        main["pending_cohorts"] == list(range(len(cycles), 11)),
        "Unstarted history differs",
    )
    dispatch = dispatch_results == {"retained": True, "selected": True}
    if complete and main["completed"] is True:
        require(
            main["completed"] is True
            and main["quality_passed"] is quality
            and main["dispatch_passed"] is dispatch
            and main["threads_restored"] is True
            and main["source_verified_after"] is True
            and main["asset_verified_after"] is True,
            "Completion/release flags differ",
        )
        require(
            wall["exit_code"] == (0 if quality and dispatch else 1),
            "Parent terminal differs",
        )
    else:
        require(
            main["completed"] is False
            and main["quality_passed"] is False
            and main["dispatch_passed"] is False
            and wall["exit_code"] == 1,
            "Incomplete negative unsupported",
        )
    descriptive: dict[str, Json] = {}
    if complete and main["completed"] is True:
        require(obj(main["ordinary_times_ms"]) == times, "Ordinary timings differ")
        selected_times = times["selected"]
        descriptive = {
            name: cast(
                Json, [a / b for a, b in zip(times[name], selected_times, strict=True)]
            )
            for name in ("original", "retained")
        }
    return {
        "audit_passed": True,
        "raw_outcomes": len(outcomes),
        "correct_outcomes": correct_total,
        "unique_cases": 8,
        "complete_schedule": complete,
        "independent_quality_passed": quality,
        "independent_dispatch_passed": dispatch,
        "accepted": False,
        "performance_passed": False,
        "descriptive_original_selected_and_retained_selected_ratios": descriptive,
        "raw_reference_gates": outcomes,
        "raw_pairwise_gates": paired,
        "profile_dispatch": cast(Json, dispatch_results),
        "main_sha256": args.main_sha,
        "journal_sha256": args.journal_sha,
        "wall_sha256": args.wall_sha,
        "log_sha256": args.log_sha,
        "source_archive_sha256": args.archive_sha,
        "source_gate_sha256": SOURCE_GATE_SHA,
        "core_gate_sha256": CORE_SHA,
        "referee_source_sha256": REFEREE_SHA,
        "validated_source_count": len(archived),
        "source_sha256": cast(Json, archived),
        "asset_sha256": cast(Json, assets),
        "history_sha256": main["historical_sha256"],
        "original_history_sha256": main["original_historical_sha256"],
        "raw_failures": sum(
            1 for row in outcomes if obj(row).get("failed_or_missing") is True
        ),
        "unstarted_cohorts": main["pending_cohorts"],
        "all_pairwise_comparison_scope": (
            "Additional diagnostic all-returned-cycle comparisons; "
            "declared anchors/ordinary pairs unchanged"
        ),
        "producer": {
            "path": str(Path(__file__)),
            "sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
            "text": Path(__file__).read_text(),
        },
        "limits": [
            "Training-source eight unique cases; model exposure unknown",
            (
                "Full fresh token encoding attested by frozen runner; auditor "
                "validates frozen vectors/recorded lengths/prefix"
            ),
            (
                "Dispatch observed only in two intrusive representative profiles; "
                "ordinary calls unprofiled"
            ),
            (
                "Two ordinary observations are descriptive, never promotion/online "
                "latency/confidence evidence"
            ),
            (
                "Parent wall terminal verified; reaping additionally "
                "source-enforced by archived owned launcher, no explicit reaped "
                "flag in wall"
            ),
            (
                "Pure referee derived softmax allows two ULP only; original engine "
                "gates unchanged"
            ),
        ],
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("main", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    for key in ("main", "journal", "wall", "archive", "log"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + key + "-sha", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    require(not args.output.exists(), "Preserve existing audit")
    result = audit(args)
    with args.output.open("x") as handle:
        json.dump(result, handle, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        handle.write("\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                name: result[name]
                for name in (
                    "audit_passed",
                    "raw_outcomes",
                    "independent_quality_passed",
                    "independent_dispatch_passed",
                )
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
